entities.name: Query protein (359 aa)
observations: Sequence length is 359 aa; estimated molecular mass is 39.87 kDa and theoretical pI is 7.06.
Pfam scanning identifies RlmN_N (PF21016.4) at residues 7–63 and Radical_SAM (PF04055.28) at residues 109–278.
The sequence contains a cysteine-rich region around residues 100–130 consistent with the radical-SAM iron-sulfur-binding region, but exact ligand assignment is not experimentally established.
Best reviewed homologs are RlmN proteins with approximately 46% identity and 90–96% query coverage.
Most likely function is dual-specificity methylation of rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37, inferred from homology and domain architecture.

entities.name: RlmN
observations: RlmN is a radical-SAM enzyme that methylates adenine C2 at position 2503 of 23S rRNA and adenine C2 at position 37 of tRNA.
Reviewed homolog annotations assign EC 2.1.1.192, cytoplasmic localization, and one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines plus an exchangeable SAM molecule.
The enzyme is associated with rRNA and tRNA binding and with rRNA/tRNA base methylation.
